desc:
🚀 Survive the Jupiter Incident

Your crew lands on Jupiter to find the outpost dark and your ship overrun by Keys. Your only way home runs through Sector C.

👨‍🚀 Play solo or team up with up to 3 friends as Darren, Case, Kreek, or Jynx.
🔑 Fight waves of Keys, find weapon upgrades, and revive your crewmates.
⚔️ Defeat Red Horror and board the rescue ship before the Keys catch up.
🏆 Unlock Hard and Nightmare, then race for the fastest clear on the leaderboard.
